# Template Showcase Examples — `--examples` reads the embedded showcase set
# without a KB selected, and is the copy source for a KB with no templates.

# === WITHOUT A KB: --examples still answers ===

# The harness selects the scenario work dir (AKB_KB=.), which holds no KB.
env AKB_KB=

# Sorted by name, so the listing is pinnable.
exec akb template list --examples
stdout '(?s)^adr: .*\nnote: .*\n$'

exec akb template get note --examples
stdout 'name: note'
stdout 'requirements:'
stdout 'Title must not be empty'

exec akb template get note --full --examples
stdout 'name: note'
stdout 'lint_rules:'
stdout 'note_stale'

exec akb template get note --example --examples
stdout 'type: note'
stdout 'This is a valid note.'
! stderr 'WARNING'

! exec akb template get nope --examples
stderr 'not found in the embedded examples'
stderr 'akb template list --examples'

# The KB-backed forms still require a base.
! exec akb template list
stderr 'usage: resolve knowledge base'

# === COPY WORKFLOW: a fresh KB has no templates ===

exec akb init copy-kb
stdout 'Initialized KB .copy-kb.'

cd copy-kb
env AKB_KB=.

exec akb template list
stdout 'No templates found'

# The refusal names both exits: author the template, or copy a showcase.
stdin ../copy-note.md
! exec akb write notes/copied.md
stderr 'unknown type .note.'
stderr 'Author .akb/templates/note.yaml'
stderr 'kb-management skill'
stderr 'akb template list --examples'
! exists kb/notes/copied.md

# Copy the showcase template and its pass mockup out of the embedded set.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout note.yaml
exec akb template get note --example --examples
cp stdout note_pass.md

# Install the copy; the fail mockup proves the rule still catches a bad page.
exec akb template write note --template note.yaml --pass note_pass.md --fail ../note-fail.md
stdout 'Template .note. written'
exists .akb/templates/note.yaml
exists .akb/templates/note_pass.md
exists .akb/templates/note_fail.md

exec akb template list
stdout 'note: General knowledge note'

# The type now validates: the same page writes.
stdin ../copy-note.md
exec akb write notes/copied.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/copied.md'
exists kb/notes/copied.md

# The KB-backed --example reads the mockup installed beside the template.
exec akb template get note --example
stdout 'This is a valid note.'

-- copy-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Copied note
---

# Copied note

Written from a template copied out of the embedded showcase set.

-- note-fail.md --
---
type: note
title: ""
summary: A note whose title is empty
tags: [test]
---

# Empty title

This note fails require_title because the title is an empty string.
